# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it privately rather than
opening a public issue. Email **security@brimham.app**, or use GitHub's private
vulnerability reporting via the **Security** tab ("Report a vulnerability").

We aim to acknowledge your report within 3 working days and will keep you updated
as we investigate and prepare a fix. Once a fix is released we will credit you,
unless you prefer to remain anonymous.

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest released version.
